notes: kb/Work PB5925 (listing step 4a of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18). §2023:7.3.18.3 GR3: "Each LISTING directive shall be listed, even if the listing is being suppressed by a LISTING directive." The driver records each LISTING directive it processes (TextStageTrace.ListingDirective), DirectiveEffectsBuilder places it on its listing line, and ListingVisibility lists that line whatever the state; the witnesses list a second LISTING OFF written under OFF and the LISTING ON that ends it. A line of library text a COPY ... SUPPRESS statement incorporated is not listed even when it is a LISTING directive: GR3's exception names suppression by a LISTING directive, and §2023:7.2.3.4 GR4 says that text "is not listed". The earlier CONFORMS rested on the signed derivation DRV-GR-7.3.18.3-3 (unpopulatable-antecedent: no listing is produced, A.1 item 117); a listing is now produced on request (cobol --listing at 2002, 2014 and 2023), so the antecedent is populated and the derivation is withdrawn.
